stem.en: The sentence is "The capital of British India in 1900 was". A model gives Calcutta a very high score. What does that high score tell you?

text.en: The model has found the answer in its records
Several sources were checked and they agreed
The token is what its patterns strongly expect
The answer is true, because tall bars are true

explanation.en: A score says how strongly the settings expect a token at this point in the text. Nothing in score, pick and add checks a fact, so a false token can get a high score too, as France did in our Toy Gym.
